about.title: About
about.license: Torsher is free software: you can use, study, change and share it under the {license} license
about.serverUnavailable: Couldn't get version information from the server
about.dataSource: Movie and series information and images are provided by TMDB
about.tmdbNotice: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
about.font: The Onest font is distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1
about.tagline: A media server with your own library and showcase
about.description: Server version, license and data sources.

player.timeline: Position {position}. OK pauses, left and right seek
player.waitingHint: Nobody is sharing this file yet. The torrent may be rare: wait or pick another one.

resume.text: You have already started watching this file.

unauthorized.title: Sign in required
unauthorized.text: Sign in to the control panel on this server and open the file again.

notFound.title: File not found
notFound.text: The torrent was deleted or the link is outdated. Open the file from Downloads in the panel.

notReady.title: The torrent isn't ready yet
notReady.text: The server is waiting for the file list from peers. Try again in a minute.

unsupported.title: The player can't open this format
unsupported.text: The player only does direct play, and this file's codec or container is beyond it. This usually happens with MKV, HEVC and AC3 audio in a browser.

unknown.title: Couldn't play the file
unknown.text: The stream broke off or the server didn't respond. Try again.

not_installed.title: The torrent engine isn't installed
not_installed.text: Torrents can't be watched without it. Install the engine on the server.

starting.title: The torrent engine is starting
starting.text: Wait a few seconds and try again.

stopped.title: The torrent engine isn't running
stopped.text: Restart the server and try again.

no_space.title: The server is low on disk space
no_space.text: Playback needs {needed} GB more, but only {available} GB is free above the reserve. Free up space in the panel: Downloads or Settings → Storage.

cache_limit.title: The file doesn't fit in the cache
cache_limit.text: Playback needs {needed} GB more, but the cache has {available} GB left. Raise the cache limit in the panel or keep the torrent.

auth.name: Name
auth.rejectedText: Check the keyboard layout and Caps Lock.

wizard.label: First run
wizard.note: Everything you set here can be changed later in the panel.

account.title: Create the owner account
account.text: You use it to sign in to the panel and set up the server. There is one account per server: the household watches through profiles on the TV.
account.emailHint: Only for signing in. The server sends no email.

account.description: The server owner account. A second one can't be created: the household watches through profiles.
account.nameText: How the panel calls you, for example in the account menu.
account.emailText: Email is only used to sign in: the server sends no email.
account.single: There is one account per server — the owner.

storage.description: Where downloads live and how much space the watch cache may take.
storage.loadErrorText: The server didn't respond. Try again.
storage.cacheText: What you watch without “Keep” stays in the cache. When it's full, the oldest is deleted automatically.
storage.reserveText: If less is left on disk, new playback won't start and the showcase explains why. Downloads pause.
storage.defaults: Defaults based on the disk size are in effect.
storage.savedText: If space is short, extra cache is deleted right away

queue.title: Deleted automatically
queue.text: When the cache is full or space runs out, these torrents go first — they haven't been opened for the longest time.
queue.empty: The cache is empty: what you watched is kept or not downloaded yet.

sources.title: Sources
sources.loadErrorText: The server didn't respond. If the panel has been open for a while, reload the page.

empty.title: Connect your first source
empty.text: The server searches for releases in Torznab indexers. Until there are some, the showcase finds movies and series but has nothing to play them from.
empty.importText: All indexers of the manager in one step. Torsher keeps them in sync after that.
empty.manualText: The address and API key of a single indexer, if you have no manager.
empty.foot: Any Torznab indexer works, for example Prowlarr or Jackett. You decide which indexers to enable in it.

progress.title: Checking indexers · {done} of {total}
progress.hint: you can switch to another section

errors.auth: The API key was rejected. Check the key and try again.
errors.timeout: The address didn't respond in time. Check that the service is running and the server can reach it.
errors.unreachable: The Torsher server couldn't reach the address. Check it; if the service runs in a neighbouring container, use its name in the Docker network.
errors.bad_response: The address answered, but not with Torznab. Check the address.
errors.remote: The indexer answered with an error. Check it in its own interface or try later.
errors.unsupported: No manager API at this address. Check the type and the address, or update the manager.

reasons.auth: Key rejected — enter a new key
reasons.timeout: Didn't respond in time — search goes on without it
reasons.unreachable: Unreachable — check the address and network
reasons.bad_response: The response doesn't look like Torznab — check the address
reasons.missing: Gone from {manager} — Torsher searches it but doesn't update it

problems.authManaged: The indexer rejected the API key. Update the key in {manager} — the next sync will pick it up.
problems.auth: The indexer rejected the API key. Enter a new key with “Edit”.
problems.timeout: The indexer didn't respond in time. Search goes through the others and skips this one until it responds.
problems.missing: The indexer is no longer in {manager}. Torsher still searches it but doesn't update it. Delete it if you don't need it.

validation.name: Enter a name
validation.url: Enter an http or https address

indexers.deleteText: The server will stop searching this indexer.
indexers.deleteManagedText: The server will stop searching this indexer. It came from {manager}, so the next sync will add it again. To keep it out of search, disable it here or delete it in {manager}.

managers.synced: Added {added}, updated {updated}, gone from the manager {missing}
managers.importedText: Added {n} indexer. Checking it — the status will update by itself. | Added {n} indexers. Checking them — statuses will update by themselves.
managers.disconnectText: Torsher will stop syncing indexers with
managers.outcome: What to do with the indexers
managers.keepText: They become manual, search keeps working.

importDialog.title: Import from Prowlarr or Jackett
importDialog.description: Torsher adds all indexers of the manager and keeps them in sync.
importDialog.urlHint: The address at which the Torsher server reaches the manager, not this computer.

keyHint.prowlarr: In Prowlarr: Settings → General → API Key.
keyHint.jackett: In Jackett: the API Key field at the top of the dashboard.

addDialog.title: Add a Torznab indexer
addDialog.description: The server checks the indexer before saving it.
addDialog.name: Name
addDialog.apiKeyHint: Leave empty if the indexer needs no key.

editDialog.title: Edit {name}
editDialog.description: The server checks a new key right after saving.
editDialog.apiKeyHint: Leave empty to keep the current key.

torrents.title: Downloads
torrents.loadErrorText: The server didn't respond. If the panel has been open for a while, reload the page.

empty.title: Add your first torrent
empty.text: A magnet link or a .torrent file — watch its videos in the showcase while they download, or download the whole torrent.
empty.foot: Free films such as Big Buck Bunny or Sintel are good for a first check.

texts.not_installed: Without it torrents can't be added or watched. Build the engine on the server or point ENGINE_PATH to a prebuilt binary.
texts.starting: It will be ready in a few seconds. If this message stays, check the server log.
texts.stopped: Torrents can't be added or watched. Restart the server.

status.resolving: Waiting for the file list from peers…
status.timeout: Peers didn't send the file list
status.rejected: The engine didn't accept the torrent

torrents.noVideo: This torrent has no video the showcase can open

addDialog.title: Add torrent
addDialog.description: The torrent appears in the list, and its videos can be opened in the showcase.
addDialog.magnetText: The file list comes from peers, usually within seconds.
addDialog.fileText: The file list is available right away.
addDialog.addedResolving: Waiting for the file list from peers — it will show up by itself
addDialog.exists: This torrent is already in the list

validation.magnet: Paste a magnet link: it starts with magnet:?xt=urn:btih:
validation.fileSize: The file is larger than 8 MB — that doesn't look like a .torrent

errors.not_installed: Build the engine on the server or point ENGINE_PATH to a prebuilt binary.
errors.starting: Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.stopped: Restart the server and try again.
errors.invalid: Check the magnet link or the .torrent file.
errors.timeout: The engine didn't respond in time. Try again.
errors.notReady: The server is waiting for the file list from peers. Try again in a minute.

reasons.stalled: No peers — the download resumes when they appear

problems.pausedStorage: Free space is below the reserve and there is nothing to free: everything in the cache is being watched or kept. Delete what you don't need or lower the reserve in Storage — the download resumes by itself.
problems.stalled: Nobody is seeding this torrent right now. Torsher continues as soon as it finds peers.
problems.failed: Peers didn't send the file list. Check the magnet link and try again, or add the .torrent file.

card.storageCache: Deleted automatically when the cache is full
card.filesHint: Checked files download in full. The rest downloads only while it's being watched.
card.title: Title

toasts.keptText: It won't be deleted when the cache is full
toasts.unkept: Torrent moved back to the cache
toasts.unkeptText: It may be deleted automatically when the cache is full
toasts.downloadStorage: Low disk space — the download is paused

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{name}”?
deleteDialog.text: The torrent disappears from the list and the engine stops downloading and seeding it.
deleteDialog.withFilesEmpty: Nothing of it is on disk.
deleteDialog.keepFiles: Remove from the list, keep files
deleteDialog.keepFilesText: Downloaded files stay on disk, but Torsher stops counting them and never deletes them automatically.
